referents.why: 'your staff' is second person masculine singular, and the staff is Aaron's: Aaron is the addressee of the inner speech (stretch out, strike).
'tell Aaron' is a command given to Moses by the LORD, so its implied you is Moses; Aaron is the one told, not the one addressed by the command.
'stretch out your staff' is a command inside the quoted message, addressed to Aaron (second person masculine singular).
'strike' is a further command in the same quoted message, so its implied you is Aaron.
the third masculine singular weqatal 'it will become gnats' takes the dust (masculine singular) as subject: the dust that the command told Aaron to strike is what becomes gnats.
referents.category: implied subject from the act before

links.why: the saying clause 'the LORD said to Moses' introduces what is said, 'Tell Aaron...'.
'tell Aaron' introduces the quoted words, which are a run of commands joined by 'and': the content is the imperative group.
links.category: speech content link to command group

links.why: a link from a later clause back to the opening speech clause is backward; the strike command sits inside the speech and is not the next event after its opening.
links.category: backward then link into speech frame

links.why: two commands joined by waw at one level, same person, so plain 'and' and not 'so that'.
a command followed by a third-person weqatal saying what it brings about is a result, not a plain next event.
the strike command, then the weqatal saying what will come of it (the dust becomes gnats); the same clause is also the effect of the imperative group.

groups.why: the LORD speaks to Moses; what Moses is told to say is a nested turn, so the commands are not direct parts of this turn.
Moses is commanded to tell Aaron, so the commanded words are spoken by Moses (the one commanded to speak them) to Aaron.
the quoted message is the LORD's words delivered by Moses; the innermost turn's sender is the one quoted.
stretch out and strike are commands joined by 'and' at one level: one imperative group, with the weqatal as its effect.
groups.category: commands joined by and as one group

groups.why: the strike command belongs to the single collection imp2; a second group for it duplicates the first.
